from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, Optional

class OverlayRequest(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["text", "banner", "pip", "alert"] = "banner"
    title: str = ""
    message: str = ""
    priority: int = Field(default=1, ge=0, le=5)
    duration: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=300)
    video_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    position: Literal["top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right", "center"] = "top-right"

class LaunchRequest(BaseModel):
    provider: str
    url: str
    title: str = ""
    season: Optional[int] = None
    episode: Optional[int] = None
    live: bool = False
    profile: str = "default"

class ProgrammeRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str
    provider: str
    url: str
    season: Optional[int] = None
    episode: Optional[int] = None
    followed: bool = True
    notes: str = ""

class ProgrammeProgressRequest(BaseModel):
    season: Optional[int] = None
    episode: Optional[int] = None
    progress_position: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    duration: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    completed: bool = False

class ProgrammeReleaseRequest(BaseModel):
    available: bool = False
    season: Optional[int] = None
    episode: Optional[int] = None
    note: str = ""

class ComplianceAckRequest(BaseModel):
    profile: str = "default"
    acknowledged: bool = True

class LocalServerRequest(BaseModel):
    kind: str = "generic"
    name: str
    address: str

class ProvisionRequest(BaseModel):
    complete: Optional[bool] = None
    profile: Optional[str] = None
    device_name: Optional[str] = None
    ha_configured: Optional[bool] = None
    audio_sink: Optional[str] = None
    ui_scale: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, ge=80, le=160)

class AudioSinkRequest(BaseModel):
    sink: str

class ProviderSessionRequest(BaseModel):
    provider: str
    profile: str = "default"
    signed_in: bool = True

from __future__ import annotations
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import re
from typing import Any

KEY="programmes"

def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")

def slug(text: str) -> str:
    value=re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+","-",text.lower()).strip("-")
    return value[:80] or "programme"

def list_programmes(store) -> list[dict[str,Any]]:
    rows=store.get(KEY,[]) or []
    if not isinstance(rows,list):
        return []
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda x:(not bool(x.get("new_release")), -(x.get("last_watched_epoch") or 0), x.get("title","").lower()))

def get_programme(store, programme_id: str) -> dict[str,Any] | None:
    for row in list_programmes(store):
        if row.get("id")==programme_id:
            return row
    return None

def upsert_programme(store, item: dict[str,Any]) -> dict[str,Any]:
    rows=store.get(KEY,[]) or []
    pid=item.get("id") or slug(item.get("title",""))
    existing=next((x for x in rows if x.get("id")==pid),{})
    merged={
        "id":pid,
        "title":str(item.get("title") or existing.get("title") or "").strip(),
        "provider":str(item.get("provider") or existing.get("provider") or "").strip(),
        "url":str(item.get("url") or existing.get("url") or "").strip(),
        "season":item.get("season",existing.get("season")),
        "episode":item.get("episode",existing.get("episode")),
        "followed":bool(item.get("followed",existing.get("followed",True))),
        "notes":str(item.get("notes",existing.get("notes",""))),
        "progress_position":int(existing.get("progress_position") or 0),
        "duration":int(existing.get("duration") or 0),
        "completed":bool(existing.get("completed",False)),
        "last_watched":existing.get("last_watched"),
        "last_watched_epoch":existing.get("last_watched_epoch",0),
        "new_release":bool(existing.get("new_release",False)),
        "release_season":existing.get("release_season"),
        "release_episode":existing.get("release_episode"),
        "release_note":existing.get("release_note",""),
        "release_checked_at":existing.get("release_checked_at"),
        "release_check_requested_at":existing.get("release_check_requested_at"),
        "updated_at":now_iso(),
    }
    if not merged["title"] or not merged["provider"] or not merged["url"]:
        raise ValueError("title, provider and url are required")
    rows=[x for x in rows if x.get("id")!=pid]
    rows.append(merged)
    store.set(KEY,rows)
    return merged

def remove_programme(store, programme_id: str) -> bool:
    rows=store.get(KEY,[]) or []
    new=[x for x in rows if x.get("id")!=programme_id]
    if len(new)==len(rows):
        return False
    store.set(KEY,new)
    return True

def update_progress(store, programme_id: str, patch: dict[str,Any]) -> dict[str,Any] | None:
    rows=store.get(KEY,[]) or []
    result=None
    for row in rows:
        if row.get("id")!=programme_id:
            continue
        for k in ("season","episode","progress_position","duration","completed"):
            if k in patch and patch[k] is not None:
                row[k]=patch[k]
        row["last_watched"]=now_iso()
        row["last_watched_epoch"]=int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
        row["updated_at"]=now_iso()
        result=row
        break
    if result is not None:
        store.set(KEY,rows)
    return result

def record_release(store, programme_id: str, patch: dict[str,Any]) -> dict[str,Any] | None:
    rows=store.get(KEY,[]) or []
    result=None
    for row in rows:
        if row.get("id")!=programme_id:
            continue
        row["new_release"]=bool(patch.get("available",False))
        row["release_season"]=patch.get("season")
        row["release_episode"]=patch.get("episode")
        row["release_note"]=str(patch.get("note",""))
        row["release_checked_at"]=now_iso()
        row["updated_at"]=now_iso()
        result=row
        break
    if result is not None:
        store.set(KEY,rows)
    return result

def request_due_checks(store, interval_hours: int=6) -> list[dict[str,Any]]:
    rows=store.get(KEY,[]) or []
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    due=[]
    for row in rows:
        if not row.get("followed",True):
            continue
        stamp=row.get("release_check_requested_at")
        is_due=True
        if stamp:
            try:
                last=datetime.fromisoformat(stamp.replace("Z","+00:00"))
                is_due=(now-last).total_seconds() >= interval_hours*3600
            except Exception:
                is_due=True
        if is_due:
            row["release_check_requested_at"]=now.isoformat(timespec="seconds")
            due.append(dict(row))
    if due:
        store.set(KEY,rows)
    return due
